minor.issue: Returns empty [] even though DB has 3 vouchers (MEOWWELCOME, GRATISONGKIR, MEOW50K). Root cause: seed.py runs once (idempotent) and stamps start_at/end_at using datetime.now() at seed time. Current DB records show start_at=2026-06-11 and end_at=2026-07-11 while server date is 2026-08-07 — vouchers are EXPIRED. Filter `end_at >= now` excludes them. Fix options: (a) run cron/re-seed to refresh voucher dates; (b) make seed idempotently update start_at/end_at on every boot; (c) extend end_at to 365 days. Impact: Frontend voucher chip UI + checkout voucher input will show nothing.

Spec/request mentions endpoints /api/admin/dashboard/{sales-trend, orders-by-status, revenue-by-category, low-stock-alert, subscriber-growth}. Actual routes are /sales-chart, /order-status-chart, /top-products, /payment-chart, /shipment-chart, /game-chart, /roulette-chart. Not a bug per se (naming choice) but there is NO revenue-by-category, low-stock-alert or subscriber-growth endpoint — if frontend expects them, they will 404. Verify frontend and either add missing endpoints or update spec/frontend.
No article or knowledge item is seeded with slug 'paws-vision'. Both fall back to the first item in the list (test tolerates this). If spec requires literal slug 'paws-vision', seed must include it.

rca of the issue: Vouchers empty RCA: /app/backend/seed.py:265-281 computes start_at=now.isoformat() and end_at=(now+30days).isoformat() and seeds vouchers only if code not present. The seed ran on 2026-06-11; today is 2026-08-07 so end_at (2026-07-11) is in the past. /api/vouchers/active filter `{'end_at': {'$gte': now}}` returns 0 docs. Mitigation: change seed to always `update_one($set={start_at, end_at})` on boot, OR extend seeded end_at to 365 days, OR wipe vouchers and re-seed via a maintenance endpoint.
